autograd_and_memory_mechanisms.warmup_graph_retention: Configurable. Default DMG ModelHandler runs full 730d graph and trims output[365:]. Specialized physical models (e.g. Hbv_1_1p) support warmup_states=True which executes the 365d warmup under with torch.no_grad():.
autograd_and_memory_mechanisms.warmup_state_detach: Supported in Hbv_1_1p via s.detach() at warmup boundary. In ModelHandler default mode, state graph is continuous.
autograd_and_memory_mechanisms.bptt_horizon: Full BPTT over the scored 365-day period (or 730-day window). No within-window truncated-BPTT is used.
autograd_and_memory_mechanisms.memory_reduction_primary_driver: Time-window sampling (730 days instead of 3652-day calibration period). Truncating the temporal sequence length from 10 years to 2 years reduces autograd graph size by 5.0x per batch.
